description: Dept of Local Government Sabaragamuwa Province - Appointed Chairman and Vice Chairman for 02 Local Government Institutions
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically deals with the reconvening of Local Government meetings for the purpose of electing Chairmen and Vice-Chairmen, which falls under electoral processes at the local government level. It is issued under the Local Government Elections Ordinance and concerns election-related administrative matters, making it clearly an Elections Gazette.
